trailhead.label: the Sonnenalpe Nassfeld on the Nassfeld pass road (B90), the board’s start

cautions: About 500 m beside the Nassfeld pass road (B90) at the Sonnenalpe, signed 50 km/h: keep your dog close on a short lead.
Grazing cattle on the alpine pastures in summer: short lead, give the herd room.
A stretch shared with mountain bikes on the Easy Way singletrail: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
